lines: Day nineteen. This is the House of Acquillae. Six men have held the same post in eighteen days.
day
The first was Edmund. He came up the line with a stub of a pencil. The quartermaster pinned on his ribbon and said: don't let the mud have it.
depot
On Day four, a direct hit took Edmund. Then Isidor, who died waiting for a bed. Roland, shot in the neck. Pavel, on a stretcher by the aid post wall. Casimir, outside a hospital with no room.
five
Five men. Five times, the family sent another. The player behind them wrote this in the first week of the war.
comment

Toby, the dog, did not eat for two days after Casimir fell. On the third day, he walked up to the new man and sat down. That man is Ulrich. A bullet grazed his ribs last night. He found the hole in his coat first, and the wound second.
dog
He bought War Bonds for the front. The post at S F ten is still held.
bonds
Seventy-four Hegemony soldiers fell today. Fifty-nine from Concord.
fell
The hospitals are holding. Medics reach most of the wounded.
hosp
At the Bone Quarry, Hegemony leads. Three hundred wins the heights.
race
Forty-seven new soldiers came up the line. Two thousand three hundred and eighty-eight hold it now.
army
Pick a side. Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD, and your soldier joins the war.
cta
